title: Fast Diffusion-GAN Model for Generating Symbolic Music with Emotions
abstract: arXiv:2310.14040v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have shown promising results for a wide range of generative tasks with continuous data, such as image and audio synthesis. However, little progress has been made on using diffusion models to generate symbolic music since this class of generative models struggles with discrete data while its iterative sampling process is computationally expensive. In this work, we propose a diffusion model integrated with a Generative Adversarial Network, aiming to mitigate the slow sampling drawback of diffusion models applied to symbolic music generation. We enable the use of diffusion model by representing symbolic music as image-like pianorolls with velocity values instead of discrete event tokens and then used a Variational Autoencoder to obtain their latent representations to train the proposed diffusion model. translated_title: 用于生成带情感符号音乐的快速扩散-生成对抗网络模型
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在图像和音频合成等众多连续数据生成任务中已展现出令人鼓舞的结果。然而，由于此类生成模型难以处理离散数据，且其迭代采样过程计算成本高昂，因此在使用扩散模型生成符号音乐方面进展甚微。在本工作中，我们提出了一种与生成对抗网络（GAN）相集成的扩散模型，旨在缓解扩散模型应用于符号音乐生成时采样缓慢的缺点。我们通过将符号音乐表示为带有力度（velocity）值的类图像钢琴卷帘，而非离散事件标记，从而实现了扩散模型的使用，随后使用变分自编码器（VAE）获取其潜在表示来训练所提出的扩散模型。我们的结果证明了所提出的扩散模型能够成功控制生成具有期望情感的符号音乐。
tldr: 本文提出一种将扩散模型与生成对抗网络结合的快速模型，通过将符号音乐表示为带力度值的钢琴卷帘并利用变分自编码器获取潜在表示，实现了可控生成带有期望情感的高效符号音乐。
en_tdlr: We propose a fast diffusion model integrated with a GAN, which represents symbolic music as image-like pianorolls with velocity values and uses a VAE to obtain latent representations, enabling efficient and controllable generation of symbolic music with desired emotions.
